3B863517E7064D29A07EAEF016666BCD.source: Ah. O Rei também manda lições, ${player}.
3B863517E7064D29A07EAEF016666BCD.target: Ah. The King sends lessons too, ${player}.

4F5F4977629D6FA7E41A004158FC0EE6.source: Na Capital dizem que esta terra engole homens. Eu prefiro acreditar que ela só tem fome de fé.
4F5F4977629D6FA7E41A004158FC0EE6.target: In the Capital they say this land swallows men. I'd rather believe it's only hungry for faith.

6A9F91C3CBC5A0CD4D4176A3B46A5D55.source: E... obrigado a você também, cavaleiro.

7E18399571CCDB6DD7F5C16B9F8996A2.target: For Him I would cross two.

9E54FAAFCBAA19E1ED81F84B54052396.source: O mar daqui tem outro cheiro. Mais verde. Mais... selvagem.
9E54FAAFCBAA19E1ED81F84B54052396.target: The sea smells different here. Greener. More... wild.

13AA3BD02CF765A0558AD46BDA96605A.source: Que as marés nos guiem. E que guiem você também, cavaleiro, mesmo que você não acredite nelas.
13AA3BD02CF765A0558AD46BDA96605A.target: May the tides guide us. And may they guide you too, knight, even if you don't believe in them.

044EB878765353017E47173D1473A2DA.source: Ó Rei das Profundezas, me guarda! Socorro!
044EB878765353017E47173D1473A2DA.target: O King of the Deep, protect me! Help!

55D8BCEE46823D841DA7F2B58BA7B55D.source: Fim do teste: a estrada da costa
55D8BCEE46823D841DA7F2B58BA7B55D.target: End of the test: the coast road

72AA98124379E961AA7324CEBA0ABD94.source: Amanhã eu te conto da missão. Hoje... hoje eu só quero agradecer ao Rei por estar vivo.
72AA98124379E961AA7324CEBA0ABD94.target: Tomorrow I'll tell you about the mission. Today... today I just want to thank the King for being alive.

79D27A63ABBC1C1B1333D469CCB249C0.source: ${player}. Você está segurando esse cajado de cabeça para baixo.
79D27A63ABBC1C1B1333D469CCB249C0.target: ${player}. You're holding that staff upside down.

196E454FAE990BAB634279532ACD0D01.source: A clareira fica subindo o riacho. Lá a gente acende um fogo e espera a tempestade passar.
196E454FAE990BAB634279532ACD0D01.target: The clearing is up the stream. We can light a fire there and wait out the storm.

564A75529063D9A1E1CE51B235DE4E32.source: ${player}. Um deus peixe? Você atravessou o mar por isso?
564A75529063D9A1E1CE51B235DE4E32.target: ${player}. A fish god? You crossed the sea for that?

755A52A701B9A3606219374ECC0002E4.source: Atrás de você, na clareira, alguém ainda grita por socorro.
755A52A701B9A3606219374ECC0002E4.target: Behind you, in the clearing, someone is still crying for help.

931EB8DE5BD2880BFAB37884EACC1AC2.source: Adepto do Culto ao Baiacu Rei
931EB8DE5BD2880BFAB37884EACC1AC2.target: Adept of the Cult of the Pufferfish King

1324E8EF9FFA2E48C0D9A1EC93F406AF.source: Ajudou! Ele mandou você, não mandou?
1324E8EF9FFA2E48C0D9A1EC93F406AF.target: He did! He sent you, didn't He?

1567EA1DFEB896B6C1A84C552CB4278C.source: Ó Rei das Profundezas, obrigado! Obrigado!
1567EA1DFEB896B6C1A84C552CB4278C.target: O King of the Deep, thank you! Thank you!

4094CBF2858B6A544BFAA1B1CB3FE2A0.source: Eu sei usar o cajado. Quer dizer... eu sei segurar o cajado.
4094CBF2858B6A544BFAA1B1CB3FE2A0.target: I know how to use the staff. I mean... I know how to hold the staff.

AAC2D839EFF7BFDE720D2924E19DC227.source: A estrada de terra segue a costa sob a tempestade. O vento traz sal, chuva e algo mais.
AAC2D839EFF7BFDE720D2924E19DC227.target: The dirt road follows the coast under the storm. The wind carries salt, rain and something else.

B6E6CA38DB1AD320BF497EE359DDC08E.source: Que bom que o seu deus te ajudou.
B6E6CA38DB1AD320BF497EE359DDC08E.target: Good thing your god helped you.

C06C425C6577E20139837755B80D5F97.source: Cuidado! Elas estão por toda parte!

C1381373B17EF5139DC1F5619163CDA9.source: Prazer, Surubin. Sou ${player}. Que bom que o seu deus te ajudou.
C1381373B17EF5139DC1F5619163CDA9.target: Pleased to meet you, Surubin. I'm ${player}. Good thing your god helped you.

D224C3328416DFA18C9E9573E1769720.source: O Rei das Profundezas mandou você, ${player}. Tenho certeza.
D224C3328416DFA18C9E9573E1769720.target: The King of the Deep sent you, ${player}. I'm sure of it.

DBCA6E00C2C4AD9B6662489E0122B9A0.source: Precisamos sair dessa chuva. Vi uma clareira subindo o riacho. Você vem?
DBCA6E00C2C4AD9B6662489E0122B9A0.target: We need to get out of this rain. I saw a clearing up the stream. Are you coming?

DCD5FD69F36E120AC5CAD896BF4D60B8.source: Sou Surubin, adepto do Culto ao Baiacu Rei. Vim de Marina para trazer a fé a esta terra.
DCD5FD69F36E120AC5CAD896BF4D60B8.target: I am Surubin, adept of the Cult of the Pufferfish King. I came from Marina to bring the faith to this land.

E3CDFB9AB9C67A9A2034E64231BFA30B.source: Um rapaz de vestes encharcadas, cercado por criaturas da mata, segura um cajado como quem nunca usou um.
E3CDFB9AB9C67A9A2034E64231BFA30B.target: A young man in soaked robes, surrounded by forest creatures, holds a staff like someone who has never used one.

E42BAE9BF4785DA548DCFF4F850D183F.source: Salve o forasteiro cercado na clareira.
E42BAE9BF4785DA548DCFF4F850D183F.target: Save the stranger cornered in the clearing.

F6EB926D5149CC93FD7CED420FCDF11B.source: Um deus peixe? Você atravessou o mar por isso?
F6EB926D5149CC93FD7CED420FCDF11B.target: A fish god? You crossed the sea for that?

F76F6592B598A20BB1668105378C2C5B.source: Você segura esse cajado de cabeça para baixo.
F76F6592B598A20BB1668105378C2C5B.target: You're holding that staff upside down.

F353EAD949536F72C787C4180E19E47C.source: Siga com Surubin pela estrada ao norte.
F353EAD949536F72C787C4180E19E47C.target: Follow the road north with Surubin.
